tables.name: Dwarf Naming Method
tables.description: Fifty equally weighted name-bank routes. 40% Ancestral Runic, 26% Deep Hall, 18% Forge & Guild, 12% Hearth & Highland, 4% Surface-influenced. Uses only ordinary given-name + clan-name joins. Clan pool has 50 great and 150 lesser names.
